executive_summary.conclusion: The sampled Fastmail public pages clearly describe a privacy-focused email, calendar and contacts service, expose pricing and security/data-residency routes, and provide business/custom-domain context. No material discoverability, answerability or trust defect was directly observed in the bounded static and retrieval sample. Browser rendering and interactive journeys were unavailable in this session, so engagement completion and rendered/accessibility behavior remain untested.

not_checked: Rendered browser journey was not available: no IAB browser surface was exposed after the prior GOV.UK case.
Interactive CTA behavior, sign-up flow, keyboard/focus/mobile/performance checks were not measured.
Actual assistant answers/citations, provider logs and analytics were not measured.
No sign-up, form submission, account, personal data, message or purchase action was attempted.

readiness.detail: Static collection retrieved the requested Fastmail origin and sampled pages without errors; crawler policy was recorded by the collector. This does not prove provider access.
Static HTML exposed service scope, trial CTA, pricing, security and residency language, business/custom-domain positioning, and policy dates.
Three task-specific questions were answered by inspected first-party pages and a first-party help source.

Bounded retrieval returned Fastmail pricing, custom-domain and residency help pages; the residency help page qualifies the EU choice with US replication, resolving a potentially material qualifier in-sample.
No browser surface was available for safe rendered journeys; static links establish routes but not successful interaction.

intent_tests.question: What does Fastmail offer and who is it for?

evidence.quote: Fast, private email hosting for you or your business. Mail Contacts Calendar

intent_tests.reason: The homepage and business page identify the offer and audiences.

intent_tests.question: What plans or cost context is available?

evidence.quote: Try free for 30 days ... No obligation, no credit card required.
All plans include Email Calendar Contacts Files ... Individual & Family Business

intent_tests.reason: The inspected homepage and pricing page provide the trial qualifier and plan families; exact locale-dependent amounts were not frozen as a requirement.

intent_tests.question: How does Fastmail address privacy and data residency?

evidence.quote: stored encrypted on disks inside locked racks in our data centers
Choose your primary data residency: EU or USA.
if you choose the EU region ... a live copy of your data is still replicated to the US.

intent_tests.reason: Security, residency choice and the material replication qualifier are all supported by opened first-party sources.

intent_tests.question: Can a business use a custom domain?

evidence.quote: Give everyone in your organization a professional email address at your domain.
A custom domain allows you to receive email at any address you like

intent_tests.reason: Business positioning and a dedicated custom-domain help page answer the test.
